answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 14192 Country: India Title: assalamu alaikum i got married july 13 2008.for one month i was happy with my husband .because of his bhabi he started fighting for silly reasons.all say that iam a good wife cause i dont argue with him, i listen to him .but he is saying bad of me to every one in his family .now he is saying that he wants to divorce me ,from past 4 months iam in my parents house .i love my husband very much .i want to save my marriage .his family members r not supporting me .no one is keeping contact with me ,inshaallah very soon i want to join my husband.i want my husband to accept me. so please help me out from this problem.allah will reward u. Question: assalamu alaikum i got married july 13 2008.for one month i was happy with my husband .because of his bhabi he started fighting for silly reasons.all say that iam a good wife cause i dont argue with him, i listen to him .but he is saying bad of me to every one in his family .now he is saying that he wants to divorce me ,from past 4 months iam in my parents house .i love my husband very much .i want to save my marriage .his family members r not supporting me .no one is keeping contact with me ,inshaallah very soon i want to join my husband.i want my husband to accept me. so please help me out from this problem.allah will reward u. Answer ID: 14192 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1094/1039=B/1430) Get 1-2 prudent and impartial persons appointed from your side and from your husband, who having attentively listened to grievances of both the husband and wife should give their judgment, which should be followed by both of you. However, recite ya Azeez ( یا عزیز ) 200 times after Isha Salah facing the house of husband and recite durood before and after. This will soften the heart of your husband for you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
